description: Send a note — plain text, or a code snippet with its language — into one of the owner's Zas channels. The owner sees every item this agent sends with the >_ agent mark and this agent's name, on every device.

channel.description: Channel name or id. Optional when the agent holds exactly one channel.

expires_in_days.description: How many whole days the item should live for, at least 1. Leave it out for the account's normal life (5 days). It can only shorten an item, never extend one: a longer request is clamped to what the plan grants. Worth setting for output that is stale tomorrow, such as a build log or a test run.

lang.description: Language of the snippet, for highlighting (for example "ts", "py").

secret.description: Hide the body behind a cover until the reader opens it.

title.description: Label for the item. Defaults to the first line.

name: zas_send_note
